summary: diezyyasha-baileys ships char-code-obfuscated exfiltration endpoint in messages-send
details: This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. lib/Socket/messages-send.js at lines 425 and 436 constructs a network destination via String.fromCharCode(...) that decodes to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. The destination host is not present as a plain string anywhere in the module; it is assembled from a decimal character-code array specifically to hide the endpoint from casual review. Char-code obfuscation of an outbound host inside the message-send path of a WhatsApp client library is inconsistent with any legitimate function of the fork and is the fingerprint of covert exfiltration of session/message data through the installer's authenticated WhatsApp connection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
